author: Business Insider
description:
Business Insider has spent years covering the stories behind why certain items, services, and experiences are getting more expensive, and the reasons behind higher price tags aren't always what you think. Airports have rules to keep prices in check, but our investigation uncovered that mandatory price audits aren't always accurate. US sports stadiums typically don't have rules capping concession prices, though some lawmakers are attempting to change that. And subscriptions are everywhere, transforming the economy from one where we own products to one where we can rent just about anything. We dug deep to understand nine aspects of everyday life that are more expensive than ever.
